text:
priya: thinking out loud — can we do a light-weight stream-verify that lets us start serving parts of a checkpoint while the rest is verified in background? goal: cut cold-start from ~1.2s to ~200ms for large models.
liam: risky but interesting. main concerns: silent corruption, hard-to-reproduce failures. need a strict mismatch policy and short grace window. metrics and tracing mandatory.
nina: agree with liam. another axis: per-layer trust levels. some layers (embeddings, small dense) are fine to serve early; projection/attention weights should probably be fully verified before use. we should make that configurable per-model.
sam: quick proposal — add a "verify_level" tag in the shard manifest and a 3-stage verifier: header -> cheap rolling checksum (crc32/xxhash) -> strong digest (sha256). start serving after header+crc if layer is low-priority. on crypto mismatch, either block or retry from primary.
priya: rough config sketch:
```
loader:
  stream_verify: true
  verify_window: 64k
  verify_levels: ["header", "crc32", "sha256"]
  partial_serve_grace_ms: 200
  mismatch_policy: "retry-primary" # options: retry-primary, block, serve-readonly
  layer_priority: {"embeddings": "low", "attn": "high"}
```
liam: prefer default mismatch_policy=block for production-critical models. allow softer defaults for dev/experimental. also: if a mismatch looks like an incomplete upload, mark manifest state "stale" and schedule re-ingest rather than immediately rolling back.
nina: telemetry we need: counters for fallback_invocations, verify_failures; gauge for bytes_verified; histogram for verify_latency; event stream entries for partial_serve_started/ended (model, shard, req_id). also expose which verify_level allowed the partial serve in the model dashboard.
priya: thought — we could include a tiny per-chunk fingerprint in the manifest (xxhash64) to make header+chunk checks cheap and deterministic without full sha. would help CDN edge partial-serve heuristics.
sam: caution: quantized artifacts can have identical bytes but different semantics after vendor-side transforms (post-quantization re-encode). add a required "quant_profile" and "format_version" in manifest; checksum semantics must include format metadata.
liam: operationally: add a circuit-breaker that turns off partial serving for a model after N verify_mismatch within T minutes. rollouts: allow canary percentage where only X% of requests are allowed to partial-serve.
priya: will draft an RFC PR outlining manifest fields, config knobs, telemetry names, and a minimal state machine for loader: {INITIAL, PARTIAL_SERVE, VERIFYING, FULL_SERVE, FROZEN_ON_MISMATCH}.
ops-bot: created calendar event "stream-verify sync" for Tue 10:00 — invites: priya, liam, nina, sam.
liam: :thumbsup:
nina: will help draft telemetry and dashboard mocks.
priya: cool. I'll open the PR and tag you all for review. thanks!
